title: First Detection of Gas-phase Methanol in a Protoplanetary Disk
question: Is gas-phase methanol present in the TW Hya protoplanetary disk, and what are its abundance and radial location?

data.sensitivity: Stacked B7 rms 2.0 mJy/beam; per-channel ~4 mJy (B7), ~5 mJy (B6)

what.value: TW Hya disk physical structure (density, temperature, UV) reproducing dust SED and CO lines

evidence.quote: We adopt the TW Hya disk physical structure from (cite: kama16) that reproduces the dust SED as well CO rotational line emission

what.value: TW Hya inclination and position angle

evidence.quote: a disk inclination and position angle appropriate for TW Hya (cite: hughes11)

what.value: Methanol molecular data (A and E type) from LAMDA

evidence.quote: the molecular data files for A- and E-type methanol from the Leiden Atomic and Molecular Database (LAMDA

recipe.method: Self calibration on continuum, continuum subtraction, dirty channel maps

recipe.goal: Stack three B7 methanol lines in uv domain
recipe.method: Concatenate after velocity regridding and image with natural weighting
Grid of LIME LTE models varying inner/outer radius (10 AU steps), abundance and vertical layer; compare stacked line profile and channel maps
assumptions: LTE; Kama et al. disk structure

answer_key.quantity: Peak S/N of stacked B7 emission
Fiducial midplane CH3OH abundance (30-100 AU ring)

evidence.quote: with a fractional abundance of $2.8\times10^{-12}$ relative to
peak column density of $\approx 3 - 6 \times 10^{12}$ cm$^{-2}$ at 30 AU
The peak flux density for the stacked line profile is 33 mJy and the rms noise is 6.5 mJy
ratio is $\approx 0.7$% if both species are located in the midplane

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum subtraction method
Which B7 transitions are stacked beyond approximate frequencies; velocity regridding details
Aperture/mask for spectrum extraction beyond the 3 sigma continuum contour
LIME settings (photons, grid) and methanol temperature/excitation assumptions
score_reason: Public data and clear stacking recipe, but modeling details and disk model are external and fit is by eye.
rediscovery_reason: Public data; stacked detection with numeric S/N and abundances is redoable, though modeling needs external disk structure.
